title: kbpy announces a missing Python at session start
goal: sh _tools/kbpy --notice prints one JSON object with systemMessage (what failed, and on Windows _tools/install-python.ps1) and exits 0 when no Python 3.11+ is found, and prints nothing when one is; a synchronous SessionStart hook with a short timeout runs it in .claude/settings.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json; test_portability.py runs it with a PATH lacking Python and with one; tools.md and plugin.md describe it.
